$schema_note: Hand-derived from Uptime Kuma source; see docs/kuma-api/monitor-types.md for prose.

field_catalogue.name: type
field_catalogue.notes: optgroups: General / Special / Passive / Specific / Database / Game Server. system-service only offered when info.runtime.platform in [linux, win32] and !info.isContainer; sip-options and tailscale-ping hidden when info.isContainer.

field_catalogue.name: subtype
field_catalogue.notes: Set to 'ping' when type becomes globalping.

field_catalogue.name: name
field_catalogue.notes: If empty on submit, UI fills defaultFriendlyName (hostname, else system_service_name, else URL host, else $t('defaultFriendlyName')).

field_catalogue.name: manual_status
field_catalogue.notes: 1 = Up, 0 = Down; null = heartbeat status stays as previous. Not exposed in MonitorJSON.

field_catalogue.name: url
field_catalogue.notes: Default 'wss://' for websocket-upgrade. isInputValid() checks protocol: http/keyword/json-query -> http:/https:, websocket-upgrade -> ws:/wss:, real-browser -> any parseable URL.

field_catalogue.name: headers
field_catalogue.notes: JSON object string, e.g. {"HeaderName":"HeaderValue"}. Validated as JSON client and server side; UI re-serialises with 4-space indent.

field_catalogue.name: pushToken
field_catalogue.notes: Generated client-side: genSecret(32) over [A-Za-z0-9]. Server never generates it. Read-only in UI; 'Reset Token' regenerates. Push URL = baseURL + '/api/push/' + pushToken + '?status=up&msg=OK&ping='.

field_catalogue.name: keyword
field_catalogue.visible_if: type in ['keyword','grpc-keyword'] (required) || (type == 'globalping' && subtype == 'dns') (regex record match, optional) || (type == 'globalping' && subtype == 'http' && responsecheck == 'keyword')
field_catalogue.notes: Required for keyword and grpc-keyword.

field_catalogue.name: remote_browser
field_catalogue.notes: null = local Chromium. UI toggle 'useRemoteBrowser'.

field_catalogue.name: game
field_catalogue.notes: Selecting a game sets port to game.options.port if port unset or equal to previous game's default.

field_catalogue.name: kafkaProducerBrokers
field_catalogue.notes: Taggable multiselect; server JSON.stringify's it.

field_catalogue.name: rabbitmqNodes
field_catalogue.notes: Each node must start with http:// or https:// (management API URL, e.g. https://node1:15672).

field_catalogue.name: hostname
field_catalogue.notes: For mqtt the hostname field holds a full URL [mqtt|mqtts|ws|wss]://host[:port]. isInputValid(): for dns/port/ping/steam/gamedig/radius/tailscale-ping/smtp/snmp/ntp must be FQDN (underscores, trailing dot, wildcard for dns allowed) or IP; dns (non-PTR) rejects IPs; dns accepts root zone '.'.

field_catalogue.name: location
field_catalogue.notes: Globalping 'magic' location; must not contain a comma.

field_catalogue.name: ipFamily
field_catalogue.notes: null = auto-select (Happy Eyeballs).

field_catalogue.name: dns_resolve_server
field_catalogue.notes: UI sets '1.1.1.1' when switching to dns and value empty. For dns: comma separated list allowed (server/monitor-types/dns.js resolveDnsResolverServers).

field_catalogue.name: port
field_catalogue.notes: UI default per type when empty/was a known default: dns 53, radius 1812, snmp 161, ntp 123, sftp 22, globalping ping 80, globalping dns 53, gamedig from game list. Sent as string by the UI; server parseInt, NaN -> null. Not shown (and so unchanged) for other types; existing value is still re-sent.

field_catalogue.name: protocol
field_catalogue.notes: Defaults on subtype change: ping -> ICMP, dns -> UDP, http -> null.

field_catalogue.name: radiusPassword
field_catalogue.notes: Reused field: snmp = community string (required, placeholder 'public'); radius = password (required); mysql = password (optional, overrides password in connection string).

field_catalogue.name: snmpV3Username
field_catalogue.notes: UPSTREAM GAP: stored via bean.import on 'add' only; editMonitor does not copy it and toJSON does not return it. Treat as write-once.

field_catalogue.name: smtpSecurity
field_catalogue.notes: secure = SMTPS (implicit TLS), nostarttls = ignore STARTTLS, starttls = use STARTTLS.

field_catalogue.name: ntpTimeOffsetThreshold
field_catalogue.notes: milliseconds

field_catalogue.name: ntpRootDispersionThreshold
field_catalogue.notes: milliseconds

field_catalogue.name: jsonPath
field_catalogue.visible_if: type in ['json-query','snmp'] (required) || (type == 'mqtt' && mqttCheckType == 'json-query') (required) || type == 'mongodb' (optional) || (type == 'globalping' && subtype == 'http' && responsecheck == 'json-query') (required)
field_catalogue.notes: JSONata expression. UI sets '$' when empty on type change.

field_catalogue.name: jsonPathOperator
field_catalogue.notes: Numeric comparison for > >= < <=; string equality for == !=; $contains for contains.

field_catalogue.name: expectedValue
field_catalogue.visible_if: same as jsonPath (mongodb optional, others required)
field_catalogue.notes: Rendered as type=number (step .01) when jsonPathOperator not in [contains, ==, !=], else text. Always a string in the payload/DB.

field_catalogue.name: docker_host
field_catalogue.notes: isInputValid(): null -> 'DockerHostRequired' error.

field_catalogue.name: databaseConnectionString
field_catalogue.notes: UI templates: sqlserver 'Server=<hostname>,<port>;Database=<your database>;User Id=<your user id>;Password=<your password>;Encrypt=<true/false>;TrustServerCertificate=<Yes/No>;Connection Timeout=<int>', postgres 'postgres://username:password@host:port/database', mysql 'mysql://username:password@host:port/database', oracledb 'localhost:1521/FREEPDB1', redis 'redis://user:password@host:port', mongodb 'mongodb://username:password@host:port/database'.

field_catalogue.name: basic_auth_user
field_catalogue.visible_if: type == 'oracledb' (required, DB user) || (type in HTTPISH && authMethod in ['basic','ntlm']) || (type == 'websocket-upgrade' && authMethod == 'basic') || (type == 'globalping' && subtype == 'http' && authMethod == 'basic')

field_catalogue.name: system_service_name
field_catalogue.notes: system-service: must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9._\-@]+$ (e.g. 'nginx', Windows 'Dnscache'); pm2: process name (no control chars). Server trims and requires non-empty.

field_catalogue.name: databaseQuery
field_catalogue.notes: SQL for sql types (optional; e.g. SELECT 1 / SELECT 1 FROM DUAL); for mongodb a JSON command (e.g. {"ping":1}), validated as JSON by server.

field_catalogue.name: conditions
field_catalogue.notes: Always send an array (also [] for other types). Reset to [] by the UI when the type changes.

field_catalogue.name: interval
field_catalogue.notes: Seconds. Server MIN_INTERVAL_SECOND = 1. UI asks for confirmation below 20 s. ntp defaults to 300. For ping the UI raises interval to ceil(min(timeout, ping_count*ping_per_request_timeout)*1.1).

field_catalogue.name: retryInterval
field_catalogue.notes: Seconds; UI keeps it equal to interval while both are equal. Must be >= 1 even when hidden.

field_catalogue.name: retryOnlyOnStatusCodeFailure
field_catalogue.notes: When true, a failing JSON query marks DOWN immediately (no PENDING retries).

field_catalogue.name: timeout
field_catalogue.notes: Seconds. UI defaults on type change: snmp 5, ping 10, kafka-producer 1, others 48; clamped to 80% of interval (not for ping). Server: timeout <= 0 -> interval*0.8 at runtime. Also used by sftp/ntp/steam implementations although hidden in the form.

field_catalogue.name: resendInterval
field_catalogue.notes: 0 = disabled; N = re-send DOWN notification every N consecutive DOWN beats.

field_catalogue.name: expiryNotification
field_catalogue.visible_if: type in HTTPISH || (type == 'globalping' && subtype == 'http'); disabled when ignoreTls
field_catalogue.notes: TLS certificate expiry notification (days from setting tlsExpiryNotifyDays).

field_catalogue.name: screenshot_delay
field_catalogue.notes: milliseconds

field_catalogue.name: domainExpiryNotification
field_catalogue.notes: Shown for types with a domain-bearing field (see DOMAIN_EXPIRY_TYPES). UI calls checkDomain to display unsupported-TLD reasons.

field_catalogue.name: ignoreTls
field_catalogue.notes: Setting it true also forces expiryNotification=false in the UI.

field_catalogue.name: cacheBust
field_catalogue.notes: Adds query param uptime_kuma_cachebuster=<random>.

field_catalogue.name: gamedigGivenPortOnly
field_catalogue.notes: UI checkbox is 'Guess port' = !gamedigGivenPortOnly (true-value=false).

field_catalogue.name: ping_count
field_catalogue.notes: DB default 1; UI default 3 for new monitors.

field_catalogue.name: ping_per_request_timeout
field_catalogue.notes: Seconds; server min 1.

field_catalogue.name: accepted_statuscodes
field_catalogue.notes: Entries are single codes '200' or ranges '200-299' as STRINGS. websocket-upgrade default ['1000'] (options 1000-4999). MANDATORY in add/editMonitor for EVERY type (server calls .every on it).

field_catalogue.name: saveResponse
field_catalogue.notes: Only effective when saveErrorResponse is also true.

field_catalogue.name: parent
field_catalogue.notes: null = none. UI may create a draft group first (type 'group', active:false) then set parent to its id. editMonitor rejects a descendant as parent ('Invalid Monitor Group').

field_catalogue.name: tags
field_catalogue.notes: NOT part of add/editMonitor payload (must be absent/undefined on add). Managed with addTag/addMonitorTag/deleteMonitorTag events. In MonitorJSON: [{tag_id, monitor_id, value, name, color}].

field_catalogue.name: notificationIDList
field_catalogue.notes: { '<notificationId>': true }. Only truthy entries are stored. New monitors get all isDefault notifications.

field_catalogue.name: oauth_scopes
field_catalogue.notes: Space separated list.

field_catalogue.name: tlsCert
field_catalogue.notes: PEM

field_catalogue.name: tlsKey
field_catalogue.notes: PEM

field_catalogue.name: tlsCa
field_catalogue.notes: PEM, optional

field_catalogue.name: proxyId
field_catalogue.notes: New monitors default to the proxy flagged default. Server stores only integers, else null.

field_catalogue.name: httpBodyEncoding
field_catalogue.notes: UI sets it to null on submit for all other types. json -> application/json (body must parse), form -> application/x-www-form-urlencoded (raw string), xml -> text/xml; charset=utf-8.

field_catalogue.name: body
field_catalogue.notes: When encoding json, must be valid JSON; UI re-serialises with 4-space indent.

field_catalogue.name: responsecheck
field_catalogue.notes: Frontend-only helper deleted by the server on add; selects whether keyword or jsonPath/expectedValue is used. Derived on load: keyword set -> 'keyword', expectedValue set -> 'json-query'.

field_catalogue.name: grpcProtobuf
field_catalogue.notes: proto3 source

field_catalogue.name: grpcBody
field_catalogue.notes: JSON

field_catalogue.name: grpcMetadata
field_catalogue.notes: No UI field in 2.5.8 but accepted by add/editMonitor and returned in MonitorJSON.

field_catalogue.name: active
field_catalogue.notes: add: if active === false the monitor is created paused (used for draft groups). editMonitor ignores it; use pauseMonitor/resumeMonitor. In MonitorJSON 'active' is the effective state (own AND parents).

websocket-upgrade.label: Websocket Upgrade
websocket-upgrade.optgroup: General Monitor Type (also listed under Specific)

group.label: Group
group.notes: allowCustomStatus; status derived from children. Children reference it via parent.

globalping.label: Globalping - Access global monitoring probes
globalping.notes: Uses setting globalpingApiToken. subtype ping|http|dns selects the sub-form.

schema.notes: Top-level value is an array of expression/group objects. andOr links an item with the previous result (first item's andOr ignored). Source: src/components/EditMonitorConditions.vue:42-60, server/monitor-conditions/expression.js:17-33, evaluator.js:38-83, operators.js:14-40.

rules: Send monitor_defaults_new merged with the type-specific values; omit 'id' and every readonly field.
accepted_statuscodes must be an array of strings for every type (server.js:751-756).
notificationIDList is an object {id: true}; it is removed from the bean and stored as relations.
kafkaProducerBrokers, kafkaProducerSaslOptions, conditions, rabbitmqNodes are JSON.stringify'ed (server.js:758-763).
active === false creates the monitor paused (server.js:795-797).
Monitor.validate() (monitor.js:1630-1785) runs; errors are returned as {ok:false, msg}.

edit_payload.signature: socket.emit('editMonitor', monitor /* must contain id */, callback)
rules: Only edit_monitor_copied_fields are applied (server.js:847-967); unknown keys are ignored (safe to send the full MonitorJSON back).
accepted_statuscodes must be an array of strings (server.js:842-845).
port is parseInt'ed; NaN -> null. proxyId must be an integer else null.
parent must not be a descendant of the monitor ('Invalid Monitor Group').
Changing type from group to something else unlinks all children.
The monitor is restarted only if it (and its parents) is active.
snmpV3Username, active, weight, tags are NOT updated by this event.
